def solution():
    # Define variables
    net_income = 1_200_000
    roas = 0.045
    op_cash_flow = 1_500_000
    prev_op_cash_flow = 1_200_000
    long_term_debt = 4_800_000
    prev_long_term_debt = 5_000_000
    current_ratio = 1.5
    prev_current_ratio = 1.3
    new_shares_issued = False
    gross_margin = 0.38
    prev_gross_margin = 0.35
    asset_turnover = 1.2
    prev_asset_turnover = 1.1

    # Calculate the Piotroski score
    score = sum([
        net_income > 0,
        roas > 0,
        op_cash_flow > 0,
        op_cash_flow > net_income,
        long_term_debt < prev_long_term_debt,
        current_ratio > prev_current_ratio,
        not new_shares_issued,
        gross_margin > prev_gross_margin,
        asset_turnover > prev_asset_turnover,
    ])

    return score
